data_description.keep_alive: Duration in seconds for Ollama to keep model in memory. -1 = indefinite, 0 = never.

data_description.enable_gatekeeper: Fast pre-flight intent classification with a small model (<100ms) before invoking the heavy primary LLM.

data_description.gatekeeper_silent: Silently dismiss accidental triggers (TV audio, chatter) with zero speech.
data_description.gatekeeper_heuristics: Instantly filter out 1-letter sounds and vocal fillers in 0ms.
data_description.gatekeeper_prompt: System prompt instructing the verifier model.
